n-eink.text: The loader’s start menu on the Note Air (GlassineOS/loader spec 004), a proposal for GlassineOS/ui#57. One board pixel is one panel pixel (portrait 1404 × 1872, 227 dpi), so every size is the loader’s. Calm, visual, clear: the GlassineOS mark and a plain title; one card per entry with an icon, its name and one line about what it does; the default card has a heavier keyline and White’s flat offset; a tap turns only that card black (one rectangle refresh, about 0.8 s), then the splash. Black and white with two flat greys (#bbbbbb offset, #cccccc in the mark). No red, no warning signs, no numbers but the deployments’ own. Nothing moves while it waits: a countdown would refresh the panel every second. No touch (the controller didn’t come up) is a state of board 1: every card but the default is drawn disabled (flat sheet grey, dim keyline, muted text and icon), the default keeps its ink and says it starts by itself in a minute. The loader follows these boards.

n-variants.text: Android shows only where the board and the ABL offer it, before Recovery. Six cards fit; with more deployments than fit, the last ones are left out, Back always stays and the foot says so. Previous kernel is a PC entry (the Note Air’s parent boots no kernel set).

n-pc.text: The PC: the same layout through GOP, in colour, over the splash, in a GlassineOS colour theme (the voice and scheme pickers: White, Editorial, Stationery in paper and night; White paper by default). Ink on paper; the default card on the highlight (behind ink text only) with the heavier keyline; the keyboard focus a 3px ring in the focus colour, 3px off the card; Enter fills the card with the accent, its text in on-accent. Meaning is never colour alone: the default has its keyline, the focus is a ring, the pick a full fill. Contrast (WCAG 2.2 AA) in all six themes: text 4.5:1 or more on paper, highlight and accent, the focus ring 3:1 or more on paper. E-ink stays black and white. The PC list (loader spec 001) follows these boards in a later change; the e-ink menu first.

n-parts.text: Every icon is a stroke on a 24-unit grid, 1.5 units wide, drawn by the loader as a 96-pixel mask. The mark is the documentation site’s (two sheets, the front one turned 6°, a pen stroke), as the splash draws it.
